name: dynamic-resolution-steady-off
description: CONTROL ARM for dynamic-resolution-steady-simple.json (runs with ?ff=dynamicResolutionSteady:off, the R7-AF controller as shipped in v0.35.18.13). The same in-page trace (the M4 2400x1800 1.125 rung: vsync median, one missed frame in ~13) must reproduce the defect §11 measured: judged by its median alone the marginal rung passes as healthy, so the controller climbs PAST it into 1.25 (which misses outright) and pays the drop. The simple rung must never do that. The DSF-1 walk frame must match the simple rung's (the controller is inert at DSF 1 either way).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour(21); s.setLightsMode('on') })()

steps.name: assert-flag-off-by-override
steps.eval: (() => { const f = window.__store.getState().featureFlags; if (f.dynamicResolutionSteady !== false) throw new Error('?ff override should turn dynamicResolutionSteady OFF, got ' + f.dynamicResolutionSteady); if (f.dynamicResolution !== true) throw new Error('dynamicResolution should stay ON, got ' + f.dynamicResolution); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: controller-on-measured-trace
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/scene/dynamicResolution.ts'); const steady = window.__store.getState().featureFlags.dynamicResolutionSteady === true; const L = m.dprLadder(1, 2); const d = m.initialDynResState(L.length); let t = 10000, n = 0, last = d.motionLevel, at1 = 0, frames = 0, above = false; const probes = []; while (t < 130000) { n++; const lvl = d.motionLevel; const dt = lvl === 0 ? 16.7 : lvl === 1 ? (n % 13 === 0 ? 33.3 : 16.7) : 33.3; t += dt; m.stepDynamicResolution(d, L, { now: t, dtMs: dt, moving: true, recording: false, steady }); if (d.motionLevel !== last) { if (d.motionLevel === 1 && last === 0) probes.push(t); last = d.motionLevel } frames++; if (d.motionLevel === 1) at1++; if (t > 11000 && d.motionLevel >= 2) above = true } const r = { steady, share1125: +(at1 / frames).toFixed(3), probes: probes.length, firstGapS: probes.length > 1 ? +((probes[1] - probes[0]) / 1000).toFixed(1) : null, above, changes: d.changes }; console.log('DRS trace ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (steady) throw new Error('control arm expects the flag off'); if (!r.above) throw new Error('control arm should climb past the marginal rung (the R7-AF defect), got ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return JSON.stringify(r) })()

steps.name: pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11, 7); l.setYaw(0.07); l.setPitch(0); window.__three.invalidate(); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: gesture-walk
steps.eval: (async () => { const sig = await import('/src/scene/cameraMotionSignal.ts'); sig.beginCameraGesture(); const t0 = performance.now(); await new Promise((res) => { const step = (now) => { const e = now - t0; window.__walkLook.setYaw(0.07 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e / 600)); window.__three.invalidate(); if (e < 2500) requestAnimationFrame(step); else res() }; requestAnimationFrame(step) }); const r = window.__dynamicResolution?.(); sig.endCameraGesture(); console.log('DRS dsf1 ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (r && r.active) throw new Error('DSF 1 must leave the controller inert, got ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return 'ok' })()

steps.name: pose-living-again
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11, 7); l.setYaw(0.07); l.setPitch(0); window.__three.invalidate(); return 'ok' })()
